title: Nigel Farage to Speak at Reform UK Conference Amid Scrutiny Over Party Finances
summary_full: Advisers to the Reform U.K. leader Nigel Farage were captured on film apparently arranging contributions from a man posing as a foreign donor.
summary_public: Advisers to the Reform U.K. leader Nigel Farage were captured on film apparently arranging contributions from a man posing as a foreign donor.
